entities.name: Pantothenate synthetase
observations: The 296-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q1J0L2 from Deinococcus geothermalis.
The enzyme is annotated as cytoplasmic and homodimeric.
The query contains Pfam Pantoate_ligase (PF02569.22), positions 8–279, i-Evalue 5.9e-102.

entities.name: Pantoate beta-alanine ligation
observations: The reaction proceeds through a pantoyl-adenylate intermediate.

entities.name: Pantothenate biosynthesis
observations: Pantothenate synthetase catalyzes the terminal step converting (R)-pantoate and beta-alanine to (R)-pantothenate in cofactor biosynthesis.

entities.name: Exact enzyme identification
observations: The sequence is assigned with exact-sequence annotation evidence: 100% identity and 100% coverage to reviewed Q1J0L2, E-value 9.2e-205.
Independent reviewed homologs show 73.1% and 56.7% identity with the same EC 6.3.2.1 reaction.
